title: THE PROFILE KEEPS A SECOND COPY IN INDEXEDDB AND ASKS THE BROWSER TO KEEP IT
why: Release fix for itch.io: games on itch default domain share one storage area that other games can read or clear, and Safari can delete script data after seven days without a click. The profile lived only in localStorage. Every save is now also mirrored into IndexedDB (written 0.4 s after saves go quiet, and when the page is hidden), the boot reads the copy back when localStorage has no save or one that will not parse (and puts back lost numbered saves), erasing a save on the title erases its copy, and navigator.storage.persist() is called once after the first click, key or touch. The key salvagerun:profile and the profile shape are unchanged.
now: The save now has a second copy the browser keeps apart from the main one, so another game on the same site clearing the storage no longer wipes progress. Watch for: a save you erased on the title staying gone, and no change at all in a normal load. Firefox may show a small permission box about keeping storage after the first click.
